description:
Cast Shields of Velis Vel by paying {W}, causing creatures you control to get +0/+1 and gain all creature types until end of turn.
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Goatnapper with haste.
The Goatnapper token enters the battlefield, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat from step 2.
